Subject: Initial tenant inventory and credential audit request

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the quick sync last week. Per our discussion, attached is a CSV export of the tenant inventory we have associated with your account (archer_tenant_inventory.csv). We need to confirm three things to complete Archer's portal onboarding and evidence handoff:

1) canonical owner for each tenant (name + email + role)
2) which accounts need ephemeral keying vs. long-lived service accounts
3) proof-of-possession for SOC2/SIG items tied to tenant resources

Can you share who on your side should own the consolidation work? We typically run a 60–90 minute workshop where we walk the teams through a mapping template and capture owners and credential types.

Proposed times: Tue 6/1 10:00–11:30 PT or Wed 6/2 14:00–15:30 PT.

Attachments: archer_tenant_inventory.csv (CSV, 48KB)

Thanks,
